notes: 🔌 The last missing wire in automatic catch-up. When the app notices you are behind, it now pulls the missing days of history itself (up to 14, one request per day) before refreshing — so a device that has been away for a week comes fully current and the bot re-runs, with nothing to press. Previously auto-refresh updated prices but left history behind, which is why the bot could stay stuck on an old date.
